steps.content: The Black Ring emits red light that strips off the clear skies layer by layer, exposing the Carnival for what it really is.
Dimness, decay, rot... The dilapidated equipment in the park is tangled in hellish tentacles. The maniac Corruptors wake up from their slumbers and let out ear-splitting howls.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Um... this is how it's supposed to feel like. This is what a Black Ring is supposed to look like.

steps.speaker: Monstrous Mascot
steps.content: I want her back... I want Hamel back, I want the amusement park back... Ahhh...!!
The demon-like bunny doll comes hurtling toward you, its coat decomposing rapidly. When it's in front of you, it raises its drumstick.
<size=44>Phew!</size>
Nightmare deflects the blow, tearing the contamination-infused drumstick into shreds. The filthy entity possessing the doll shows under the torn bunny head.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Argh... Argh... So much pain... So much pain...

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Hamel... Hamel... Where are you...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's not here anymore. Wake up and face the music.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: <size=44>No...!!</size>
The Corruptor lets out a deafening cry and clutches its own neck before disintegrating into bubbles.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Record what you just said and air it. Then we can stand aside and watch them die before us.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's not that simple.
Hamel is gone, taking the grandiose mirage she created with her. But the parade is still ongoing.
The carousing dolls shed their disguises one after another, returning to their messy, filthy forms. They are coalescing left and right.
The howling army of monsters is crawling out of the dirty Rust, and they are moving as one dark block in the same direction.

steps.speaker: Monsters
steps.content: Bring me comfort! Bring us comfort! We want our revelries back!

The symphony has stopped, and is now replaced by the ebb and flow of the monsters' howling. This is a hellish scene. And the monsters are drawn to the tallest structure in the park—the colossal Ferris wheel.
The wheel lights up and starts turning slowly. Then you hear laughter coming from high above, crisp and all-penetrating. It belongs to that woman.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Come... Keep me company... I will bring you comfort, I will bring you joy!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's making the monsters go berserk.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is that also Hamel?
You don't have a definite answer. But there's one thing you're sure about.
This is the real Black Ring, not an illusory realm. You need to get ready to fight.
